title: Deployment health exposes failed checks through failing HTTP status
blast: Non-ready deployments and failed health probes return non-success HTTP status and error diagnostics, allowing cron execution history and HTTP monitors to observe failure.
evidence: app/api/cron/deploy-health/route.ts:29; app/api/cron/deploy-health/route.ts:73; graph/evidence/clm_hot_deploy_health_false_success_20260909-green.txt (shared deployment/outreach run: 12 tests passed).

title: Rejected inactivity emails no longer consume outreach cooldown
blast: A provider-rejected nudge is counted as failed and does not write a cooldown or companion notification. Partial failures return non-success status. This is not a general exactly-once guarantee across provider acceptance and later database writes.
